declarations.name: BlockSignCount.roots_of_disjoint_sign_changes
declarations.signature:
theorem roots_of_disjoint_sign_changes {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Ioo (a i) (b i)) (Ioo (a j) (b j))))
    (hsign : ∀ i, (P.eval (a i) < 0 ∧ 0 < P.eval (b i)) ∨
      (P.eval (b i) < 0 ∧ 0 < P.eval (a i)))
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ x : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ i, x i ∈ Ioo (a i) (b i) ∧ P.eval (x i) = 0) ∧
      Function.Injective x ∧
      P.roots = (Finset.univ.image x).val ∧
      P.natDegree = Fintype.card ι

declarations.name: BlockSignCount.roots_of_robust_margins
declarations.signature:
theorem roots_of_robust_margins {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Ioo (a i) (b i)) (Ioo (a j) (b j))))
    (F E : ℝ → ℝ)
    (herr : ∀ i, |P.eval (a i) - F (a i)| ≤ E (a i) ∧
      |P.eval (b i) - F (b i)| ≤ E (b i))
    (hmargin : ∀ i, (E (a i) < F (a i) ∧ F (b i) < -E (b i)) ∨
      (E (b i) < F (b i) ∧ F (a i) < -E (a i)))
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ x : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ i, x i ∈ Ioo (a i) (b i) ∧ P.eval (x i) = 0) ∧
      Function.Injective x ∧
      P.roots = (Finset.univ.image x).val ∧
      P.natDegree = Fintype.card ι

declarations.name: BlockSignCount.exact_block_counts
declarations.signature:
theorem exact_block_counts {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0) (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Ioo (a i) (b i)) (Ioo (a j) (b j))))
    (hsign : ∀ i, (P.eval (a i) < 0 ∧ 0 < P.eval (b i)) ∨
      (P.eval (b i) < 0 ∧ 0 < P.eval (a i)))
    (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card ι)
    (label : ι → κ) (U : κ → Set ℝ)
    (hU : Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (U j) (U k)))
    (hloc : ∀ i, Ioo (a i) (b i) ⊆ U (label i)) :
    ∀ j, rootCountIn P (U j) = labelCount label j

declarations.name: RhCountingAudit.interleaved_prefix_bounds
declarations.signature:
theorem interleaved_prefix_bounds {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    (n : ℕ) (r c : ℕ → α)
    (h : ∀ i < n, r i < c i ∧ c i < r (i + 1)) (t : α) :
    prefixCount n c t ≤ prefixCount (n + 1) r t ∧
      prefixCount (n + 1) r t ≤ prefixCount n c t + 1

declarations.name: RhCountingAudit.common_cells_prefix_discrepancy
declarations.signature:
theorem common_cells_prefix_discrepancy {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    (n : ℕ) (p b c : ℕ → α)
    (hp : ∀ i < n, p i < c i ∧ c i < p (i + 1))
    (hb : ∀ i < n, b i < c i ∧ c i < b (i + 1)) (t : α) :
    prefixCount (n + 1) p t ≤ prefixCount (n + 1) b t + 1 ∧
      prefixCount (n + 1) b t ≤ prefixCount (n + 1) p t + 1

declarations.name: RhCountingAudit.roots_eq_of_distinct_witnesses
declarations.signature:
theorem roots_eq_of_distinct_witnesses (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (hx : Function.Injective x)
    (hz : ∀ i, P.eval (x i) = 0) (hdeg : P.natDegree ≤ d) :
    P.roots = (univ.image x).val

declarations.name: RhCountingAudit.roots_eq_of_ordered_cell_witnesses
declarations.signature:
theorem roots_eq_of_ordered_cell_witnesses (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (d : ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (hb : Monotone b) (x : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hcell : ∀ i, b i.val < x i ∧ x i < b (i.val + 1))
    (hz : ∀ i, P.eval (x i) = 0) (hdeg : P.natDegree ≤ d) :
    P.roots = (univ.image x).val
